summary: First full E2E test pass for 'Watches by M.S' luxury watch e-commerce. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass (root, collections, products, search, checkout stub). Frontend: all critical user flows working — home rendering, hero CTA navigation, theme toggle with localStorage persistence (ms-theme), mobile drawer at <768px with Men/Women/Luxury/Smart/Limited links, search overlay (q=gold returns 3 results), product page (add-to-cart increments cart badge to 1, opens drawer, qty +/- and wishlist-pdp present), cart drawer checkout POSTs to /api/checkout and redirects to /checkout/confirm?order=<id>, wishlist page loads, account page renders 6 dashboard cards (Orders/Warranty/Addresses/Boutique/Concierge/Settings), collection /luxury renders hero + 6 product grid. Footer source has Shop & Support sections.

minor.issue: Accepts lines with non-existent product_id silently (skips them and returns total=0). Acceptable for stub, but consider 400 once Shopify integration lands.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses lowercase `fetchpriority` prop on which triggers React console warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?'. Change to camelCase `fetchPriority`.
Pagination dot buttons inside `data-testid='hero-dots'` lack individual `data-testid='hero-dot-{idx}'` attributes — testability gap per spec. Visually 5 dots exist and are clickable.
6 dashboard cards render correctly but each <Card> lacks individual `data-testid='account-card-{slug}'` — testability gap.

issues: Dark mode applies cleanly across hero, marquee, header; light mode purple palette also clean — no contrast issues spotted.

action_items: Rename `fetchpriority` -> `fetchPriority` in /app/frontend/src/components/HeroSlider.jsx line 60 to clear React DOM-prop warning.
(Optional, low priority) Add individual data-testid on hero dot buttons (`hero-dot-{idx}`) and account cards (`account-card-{slug}`) per spec for better test coverage.
When Shopify Storefront credentials arrive, replace the stub in POST /api/checkout to call cart.checkoutUrl.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured under 250 lines; all routes async; MongoDB _id excluded via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
Seed runs only when collections/products empty — idempotent. Good.
Checkout endpoint silently skips invalid product_ids — fine for the stub, but log a warning for observability.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via api.js wrapper — env var compliance verified.
Pydantic Product model uses extra='ignore' which is forgiving; consider extra='forbid' in strict mode once schemas stabilize.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; minor testability gaps only)

test_credentials: N/A — app has no auth; account page is a static placeholder until Shopify Customer Accounts are wired.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 8 collections + 12 products on startup when DB empty. No additional seed needed. Test artifacts: one stub order is inserted into MongoDB `orders` collection per checkout test (3 documents).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All MVP flows verified end-to-end. Cart/wishlist/theme are zustand+localStorage. POST /api/checkout is intentionally a stub returning /checkout/confirm?order=<id> until Shopify Storefront API credentials are added — do NOT flag as bug. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable for regression. Only remaining nit is the lowercase `fetchpriority` React warning in HeroSlider.jsx line 60 and missing per-item data-testid on hero dots & account cards.
